paper.title_en: The Page Transition in the Multi-Time Correlations of Hawking Radiation
paper.abstract_en: The Page curve and the island formula describe a reorganization of quantum information in Hawking radiation across the Page time. We study how this reorganization appears in correlations among emissions collected at several retarded times. The late radiation is treated as a covariant multi-time process, or process tensor, and $χ_{\mathrm{island}}=\mathcal{N}_{\varnothing}-\mathcal{N}_{R}$ measures the temporal memory removed when the early radiation register $R$ is supplied. Operationally, this quantity is the corresponding change in the optimal distinguishability of the radiation process from a Markovian reference. We exhibit evaporation processes whose single-bin states and all process marginals below a finite order $k_\ast\geq 3$ remain fixed and coincide with a CP-divisible reference, while $χ_{\mathrm{island}}$ changes by order one at order $k_\ast$. The Page transition can therefore appear as a transition in the Markov order of the radiation process. When the interior mediates the late-time memory, entanglement-wedge reconstruction of the predictive interior from $R$ Markovianizes the late process; conversely, when the late process has a minimal predictive memory and its future-affecting information is mediated by that memory, Markovianization by $R$ supplies a simulator of its influence. A Hayden--Preskill evaporation comb and an evaporating-JT calculation realize this mechanism. The late radiation retains temporal memory across the transition, while the early radiation becomes sufficient for predicting its future multi-time statistics.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 本文以过程张量与马尔可夫阶为核心，研究霍金辐射多时间关联中的Page转变，将island公式与量子信息重构联系起来，并给出Hayden-Preskill梳与蒸发JT两个具体实现，理论深度与新颖性较高，适合索引推荐。
decision.title_zh: 霍金辐射多时间关联中的Page转变
decision.abstract_zh: Page曲线与island公式描述了跨越Page时间时霍金辐射中量子信息的重组。我们研究这种重组如何体现在若干推迟时间上收集的发射之间的关联中。晚期辐射被当作一个协变的多时间过程，即过程张量，而$\chi_{\mathrm{island}}=\mathcal{N}_{\varnothing}-\mathcal{N}_{R}$度量了当早期辐射寄存器$R$被提供时所移除的时间记忆。在操作层面，该量是对应于辐射过程与一个马尔可夫参考之间最优可区分度的变化。我们展示了一些蒸发过程，其单bin态以及所有低于某有限阶$k_\ast\geq 3$的过程边缘分布保持固定，并与一个CP可除参考一致，而$\chi_{\mathrm{island}}$在阶$k_\ast$处改变量级为一的变化。因此，Page转变可以表现为辐射过程马尔可夫阶的转变。当内部介导了晚期记忆时，从$R$对预测性内部进行的纠缠楔重构使晚期过程马尔可夫化；反之，当晚期过程具有最小预测记忆、且其影响未来的信息由该记忆介导时，由$R$进行的马尔可夫化提供了其影响的模拟器。一个Hayden--Preskill蒸发梳和一个蒸发JT计算实现了该机制。晚期辐射在转变过程中保留了时间记忆，而早期辐射变得足以预测其未来的多时间统计。
